No source defect or unfulfilled security-side local acceptance condition survived review.

Production tracing covered zero-take initialization and disabled updates; post-activation disable-only reserve changes; absorbing status 4; disabled flash/interest/bad-debt-auction paths; strict positive/fresh prices; public supplier-loss default; pool-address collateral custody; debt-zero orphan settlement; rollback after final liquidation fill; and all six ADR0011 ABI-preserving first-statement traps. The direct-default path checks raw collateral, rejects auction/backstop/emissions contradictions before mutation, burns debt shares, applies ceiling-rounded supplier loss clamped at zero, moves collateral shares to pool-owned noncollateral supply, and stores atomically. Pool-owned position identities are blocked from submit. The critical final-fill regression establishes the exposed filler is healthy before the call, observes contract error 1205 plus byte-equal ledger/auction rollback, then uses an independently funded filler to prove the same fill succeeds and to assert debt burn, custody, reserve loss, auction deletion, and post-fill health consequences.

The committed receipts report 490 native/Wasm tests passed (0 failed; 1 intentionally ignored differential in the ordinary suite), exact differential 1/1 passed in 243.32s, and exact generated property 10,000/10,000 at seed 9110008 in 28184.17s. The terminal property transcript records 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 filtered and the Wasm-registered bounds. The rejected standalone differential selected zero tests and is explicitly quarantined in exact-local-candidate.json; the accepted transcript is logs/exact-local-differential-executed.log and records 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored, 0 filtered. Differential review covered common-domain raw and normalized snapshots, full failed-call event records, six stock-positive prepared trap controls, exact divergent controls, role-specific pool/backstop/factory executable normalization, TTL-swap detection with distinct role TTLs, and reverse recovery. Exact artifact receipts report all three producer roots equal, pool/backstop/factory ABI hashes equal to baseline, and factory Wasm byte-equal; payload and differential manifests retain hashes for the frozen corpus/archive. I did not run builds, tests, linters, formatters, payloads, or network calls.

Issue history was reviewed in full: all 19 recorded development/review problems at evidence-report lines 172-194 have a final disposition. These include wrong-toolchain lockfile contamination, migrated emissions fixtures, factory nonzero-take fixtures, sealed-reserve control repair, sequence-based auction maturity, three final-fill oracle defects (identity/status, weak emissions discriminator, and outcome-tolerant 1200), failed-call event API confusion, stale-Wasm mtime suspicion, role-normalization TTL masking, missing raw/normalized observations, lost earlier 10k evidence, dirty-tree provenance labeling, void-return evidence, vacuous auction-storage assertion, cleanup defects, hash-reuse integration errors, and unsupported agent claims. Superseded/rejected artifacts remain clearly labeled and are not used for this verdict.

This is local security acceptance of the exact committed source/evidence pair, not production, publication, external-audit, routing, activation, or deployment approval. The report’s “pending” wording describes its pre-commit/pre-final-review checkpoint; the evidence branch ref now proves the payload commit exists. The sequential correctness/maintenance review must still accept this same pair before combined local final acceptance.
